data.narrative:
Skyeton is a Growth-stage company in the Defense & Security sector founded by Oleksandr Stepura. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 2 public peers (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private peers, including Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, Saronic, and Quantum-Systems. This represents the broader Defense & Security peer set; however, the addressable narrow comp pool is limited.

The peer-median method was not applicable in this analysis. Of 22 same-sector peers identified, none met simultaneous filters for stage alignment, temporal adjacency, or valuation-tier similarity—each criterion individually yielded fewer than three datapoints. A sector-wide median would introduce material selection bias and obscure Skyeton's specific positioning. No triangulated valuation range could therefore be supported through conventional multiples-based approaches.

The primary constraint on valuation inference is the absence of sufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables with disclosed metrics. Further work would require either: (1) expansion to earlier-stage or later-stage Defense & Security peers with documented funding rounds; (2) disclosed revenue, EBITDA, or ARR figures from the identified private peer set; or (3) explicit transaction multiples from recent M&A in the sector. Without these data inputs, a quantitative valuation range cannot be responsibly articulated. Stakeholders should prioritize obtaining comparable transaction detail before proceeding to term negotiation.
